title: 13 Going on 30
curatorNote: Comédia romântica clássica com Jennifer Garner e Mark Ruffalo. Uma garota de 13 anos inconformada com sua aparência e popularidade na escola deseja ter 30 anos e acorda no futuro.
curatorReason: Uma reflexão calorosa sobre as armadilhas de rejeitar a própria juventude em busca de uma validação estética superficial e vazia.

omdb.title: 13 Going on 30
omdb.actors: Jennifer Garner, Mark Ruffalo, Judy Greer
omdb.plot: After total humiliation at her thirteenth birthday party, Jenna Rink wants to just hide until she's thirty. Thanks to some magic wishing dust, Jenna's prayer has been answered. With a knockout body, a dream apartment, a fabulous wardrobe, an athlete boyfriend, a dream job, and superstar friends, this can't be a better life. Unfortunately, Jenna realizes that this is not what she wanted. The only one that she needs is her childhood best friend, Matt, a boy that she thought destroyed her party. But when she finds him, he's a grown up, and not the same person that she knew.

title: Miss Congeniality
curatorNote: Comédia de grande sucesso com Sandra Bullock como Gracie Hart, uma agente durona do FBI que precisa se disfarçar como concorrente no concurso de Miss Estados Unidos.
curatorReason: Sátira inteligente sobre as pressões estéticas impostas às mulheres e a desmistificação do que significa beleza, feminilidade e valor próprio.

omdb.title: Meet the Parents
omdb.writer: Greg Glienna, Mary Ruth Clarke, Jim Herzfeld
omdb.actors: Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro, Teri Polo
omdb.plot: Madly in love with charming schoolteacher Pam, Greg Focker, an unambitious Chicago nurse and chronic underachiever, wants to make a good impression on her father, Jack, more than anything. And, in the following 48 hours, against the backdrop of a hectic weekend at her parents' house, Greg will have to put his skills to good use and, hopefully, charm his way out of trouble. However, there is one tiny detail: Jack has a knack for uncovering the truth, and Greg has been quite economical with it. Under those circumstances, will he ever get Jack's approval? Above all, is love blind?
omdb.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 7 wins & 15 nominations total

title: The Princess Diaries
curatorNote: Clássico moderno dirigido por Garry Marshall estrelando Anne Hathaway como Mia Thermopolis, uma adolescente tímida e desajeitada que descobre ser herdeira do trono de Genovia.
curatorReason: A icônica jornada de superação da timidez patológica e da autocrítica corporal, descobrindo liderança autêntica além das transformações visuais.

omdb.title: The Princess Diaries
omdb.actors: Julie Andrews, Anne Hathaway, Hector Elizondo
omdb.plot: Mia Thermopolis (Anne Hathaway) is the average teenager - sweet, a little geeky, and pretty much invisible to everyone with the exception of her mother, best friend Lilly (Heather Matarazzo) and Lilly's older brother Michael (Robert Schwartzman). Making it through high school without throwing up is a challenge in itself for Mia, so it doesn't come as welcome news when her estranged grandmother, Queen Clarisse Renaldi (Dame Julie Andrews), shows up out of the blue and calmly informs her that she is in fact the heir to the throne of a European country called Genovia. Suddenly Mia's life is thrown into complete overload. She's being taught about scarves, waves, and pears in order to become a perfect Princess, she gets a makeover and a tough looking, yet sweet bodyguard and limo driver called Joe (Hector Elizondo). Things get out of hand when the media gets a hold of the story and suddenly Mia is thrust into the spotlight in the newspapers and in school. On top of all of that, Mia has a choice to make. She must decide by Genovia's Independence Day Ball whether she will relinquish her claim to the throne or to become the Princess and heir to the throne her father, Philippe Renaldi (Rene Auberjonois), and grandmother want her to be.

title: Hairspray
curatorNote: Musical contagiante com Nikki Blonsky, John Travolta e Zac Efron. Em Baltimore nos anos 60, Tracy Turnblad, uma garota gorda e cheia de talento, sonha em dançar na TV.
curatorReason: Um hino vibrante contra a gordofobia e o preconceito racial, provando que a alegria e o carisma quebram qualquer padrão rígido de beleza.

omdb.title: Hairspray
omdb.writer: Leslie Dixon, John Waters, Mark O'Donnell
omdb.actors: John Travolta, Queen Latifah, Nikki Blonsky
omdb.plot: Tracy Turnblad, a teenager with all the right moves, is obsessed with the Corny Collins Show. Every day after school, she and her best friend Penny run home to watch the show and drool over the hot Link Larkin, much to Tracy's mother Edna's dismay. After one of the stars of the show leaves, Corny Collins holds auditions to see who will be the next teen regular. With the help of her friend Seaweed, Tracy is chosen, angering evil dance queen Amber Von Tussle and her mother Velma. Tracy then decides that it's not fair that black kids can only dance on the show once a month (on "Negro Day"), and with the help of Seaweed, Link, Penny, Motormouth Maybelle, her father, and Edna, she's going to integrate the show.....without denting her 'do.
omdb.awards: Nominated for 1 BAFTA Award. 21 wins & 45 nominations total

title: Uglies
curatorNote: Ficção científica distópica baseada na obra de Scott Westerfeld com Joey King. Em uma sociedade futurista, todos os jovens de 16 anos são forçados a fazer cirurgias plásticas radicais para se tornarem 'Perfeitos'.
curatorReason: Crítica direta e contundente à ditadura da beleza digital, à padronização cirúrgica dos rostos e ao apagamento da individualidade humana.

omdb.title: Mahô no ito ni kakeru
omdb.actors: Tomorowo Taguchi
omdb.plot: N/A

title: Clueless
curatorNote: Clássico adolescente cult de Amy Heckerling livremente inspirado em 'Emma' de Jane Austen, com Alicia Silverstone e Brittany Murphy.
curatorReason: Analisa com inteligência e humor as ilusões das reformas estéticas escolares e o momento crucial em que a autenticidade vence as aparências fúteis.

omdb.title: Clueless
omdb.actors: Alicia Silverstone, Stacey Dash, Brittany Murphy
omdb.plot: Cher, a high school student in Beverly Hills, must survive the ups and downs of adolescent life. Her external demeanor at first seems superficial, but rather it hides her wit, charm, and intelligence which help her to deal with relationships, friends, family, school, and the all-important teenage social life.

title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
curatorNote: Fenômeno de bilheteria escrito e estrelado por Nia Vardalos. Toula, uma mulher grego-americana de 30 anos que se sente feia e invisível na família, decide mudar de vida e estudar.
curatorReason: Um retrato ternamente cômico sobre autoestima, amadurecimento tardio e a libertação dos rótulos impostos pela expectativa alheia.

omdb.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
omdb.actors: Nia Vardalos, John Corbett, Michael Constantine
omdb.plot: Toula Portokalos is 30, Greek American, and works in her family's restaurant, Dancing Zorba's, in Chicago. All her father Gus wants is for her to get married to a nice Greek boy. But Toula is looking for more in life. Her mother convinces Gus to let her take some computer classes at college (making him think it's his idea). With those classes under her belt, she then takes over her aunt's travel agency (again making her father think it's his idea). She meets Ian Miller, a high school English teacher, WASP, and dreamboat she had made a fool of herself over at the restaurant; they date secretly for a while before her family finds out. Her father is livid over her dating a non-Greek. He has to learn to accept Ian; Ian has to learn to accept Toula's huge family, and Toula has to learn to accept herself.
omdb.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 20 wins & 29 nominations total

title: Beauty and the Beast
curatorNote: Primeira animação da história indicada ao Oscar de Melhor Filme. Um príncipe arrogante é transformado em uma Fera horrível e isola-se em profundo autodesprezo e amargura.
curatorReason: A lição perene sobre a feiura exterior gerada pela vaidade cruel e a redenção emocional através da gentileza, compaixão e amor desinteressado.

omdb.title: Beauty and the Beast
omdb.writer: Linda Woolverton, Roger Allers, Brenda Chapman
omdb.actors: Paige O'Hara, Robby Benson, Jesse Corti
omdb.plot: Having lived a life in selfishness, young Prince Adam is cursed by a mysterious enchantress to having the appearance of a monstrous beast. His only hope is to learn to love a young woman and earn her love in return in order to redeem himself. Ten years later, his chance shows itself when a young maiden named Belle (Paige O'Hara) offers to take her ill father Maurice's (Rex Everhart's) place as his prisoner. With help from the castle's enchanted staff, Belle learns to appreciate her captor and immediately falls in love with him. Back in the village however, unscrupulous hunter Gaston (Richard White) has his own plans for Belle.

title: Mean Girls
curatorNote: Comédia geracional escrita por Tina Fey com Lindsay Lohan e Rachel McAdams. Uma adolescente educada na África entra na escola pública dos EUA e ingressa no grupo das populares 'Poderosas'.
curatorReason: Uma dissecação mordaz sobre como a insegurança com a própria aparência alimenta rivalidades tóxicas, humilhações e obsessões com a perfeição corporal.

omdb.title: Mean Girls
omdb.actors: Lindsay Lohan, Jonathan Bennett, Rachel McAdams
omdb.plot: Lindsay Lohan stars as Cady Heron, a 16 year old homeschooled girl who not only makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels (Jonathan Bennett), the ex-boyfriend of queenbee Regina George (Rachel McAdams), but also unintentionally joins The Plastics, led by Regina herself. Join Cady as she learns that high school life can and will be really tough.

title: Lady Bird
ptTitle: Lady Bird: A Hora de Voar
curatorNote: Indicado a 5 Oscars, escrito e dirigido por Greta Gerwig com Saoirse Ronan e Laurie Metcalf. Uma jovem no último ano do colégio luta com sua identidade, origem humilde e expectativas familiares.
curatorReason: Crônica realista e afetuosa sobre a dor de querer ser especial, a vergonha socioeconômica e a complexa relação materna de amor e atrito.

omdb.title: Hidden Figures
omdb.writer: Allison Schroeder, Theodore Melfi, Margot Lee Shetterly
omdb.actors: Taraji P. Henson, Octavia Spencer, Janelle Monáe
omdb.plot: As the United States raced against Russia to put a man in space, NASA found untapped talent in a group of female African-American mathematicians that served as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in U.S. history. Based on the unbelievably true life stories of three of these women known as "human computers", follow these women as they quickly rose the ranks of NASA alongside many of history's greatest minds specifically tasked with calculating the momentous launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit, and guaranteeing his safe return. Dorothy Vaughan, Mary Jackson, and Katherine Goble Johnson crossed all gender, race, and professional lines while their brilliance and desire to dream big, beyond anything ever accomplished before by the human race, firmly cemented them in U.S. history as true American heroes.
omdb.awards: Nominated for 3 Oscars. 37 wins & 96 nominations total

streamName: Lady Bird: A Hora de Voar

title: The Way, Way Back
curatorNote: Sensível drama cômico com Liam James, Steve Carell e Sam Rockwell. Um tímido garoto de 14 anos com baixa autoestima passa o verão com a mãe e o padrasto insensível que o considera um 'zero à esquerda'.
curatorReason: A descoberta libertadora da autoconfiança e do valor próprio através do acolhimento inesperado em um parque aquático local.

omdb.title: The Way Way Back
omdb.actors: Steve Carell, Toni Collette, Allison Janney
omdb.plot: Duncan (Liam James) is not a popular kid and it doesn't look like the summer is going to offer anything better for him. His mother's boyfriend has invited them to his beach house where Duncan is expected to improve his personality and physical appearance, and meet girls. But his would-be step-sister doesn't want anything to do with him and his shy demeanor makes it difficult for him to meet anybody new. When Duncan wanders into the Water Wizz, the local water park, he meets adult employees who are just having fun. Owen (Sam Rockwell) lets Duncan work with him and their new-found bond will help each other mature and find their place in life. Which for Duncan means standing up to his would-be step-father, having a conversation with the girl next door and being more comfortable with who he is.

title: Big
curatorNote: Clássico de Penny Marshall com atuação lendária de Tom Hanks indicada ao Oscar. Humilhado por sua baixa estatura em um parque de diversões, um garoto de 12 anos pede a uma máquina para ser grande.
curatorReason: Uma fábula encantadora sobre a pressa em crescer motivada pela insegurança corporal e o resgate da pureza interior da infância.

omdb.title: Big
omdb.actors: Tom Hanks, Elizabeth Perkins, Robert Loggia
omdb.plot: Josh Baskin would do anything to be big to hang out with his crush, Cynthia, at the carnival. He finds a Zoltar machine, and he wishes to be big. After Zoltar tells him, "Your wish is granted," he notices that it's unplugged. He wakes up the next morning in an adult's body, but he still has the same personality. With the help of his best friend, Billy, he learns how to act like an adult. But as he gets a girlfriend and a fun job, he doesn't want to be a kid again. Will Josh stay big or become a 13-year-old boy again?
omdb.awards: Nominated for 2 Oscars. 12 wins & 15 nominations total

title: Roxanne
curatorNote: Releitura moderna e charmosa de Cyrano de Bergerac escrita e estrelada por Steve Martin com Daryl Hannah. O chefe dos bombeiros de uma cidadezinha tem um nariz gigantesco que destrói sua autoconfiança amorosa.
curatorReason: Um elogio espirituoso ao humor como escudo contra piadas cruéis e a revelação de que a inteligência e o afeto superam qualquer traço físico incomum.

omdb.title: Roxanne
omdb.actors: Steve Martin, Daryl Hannah, Rick Rossovich
omdb.plot: In Nelson, Fire Chief C. D. Bales is a man with a complex: he has a huge nose. His friend Dixie rents a house to a gorgeous astronomy student, Roxanne, and C.D. falls in love with her but keeps his feelings as a secret. C.D. hires the handsome fireman Chris, and Roxanne asks C.D. to help her meet him. However, Chris is an average guy with very limited culture, so he asks C.D. to help him seduce Roxanne. C.D. writes letters disclosing his feelings for her and Roxanne is seduced by the man that writes such letters. What will happen when she meets Chris?

title: Bridget Jones's Diary
curatorNote: Clássico contemporâneo com atuação indicada ao Oscar de Renée Zellweger ao lado de Colin Firth e Hugh Grant. Uma mulher solteira em Londres registra sua luta contra o peso, cigarros e a busca por amor.
curatorReason: O monumento à imperfeição charmosa: a celebração inesquecível de uma protagonista amada 'exatamente do jeito que ela é'.

omdb.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
omdb.writer: Helen Fielding, Andrew Davies, Richard Curtis
omdb.actors: Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Hugh Grant
omdb.plot: Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) is an average woman struggling against her age, her weight, her job, her lack of a man, and her many imperfections. As a New Year's Resolution, Bridget decides to take control of her life, starting by keeping a diary in which she will always tell the complete truth. The fireworks begin when her charming though disreputable boss takes an interest in the quirky Miss Jones. Thrown into the mix are Bridget's band of slightly eccentric friends and a rather disagreeable acquaintance into whom Bridget cannot seem to stop running or help finding quietly attractive.
omdb.country: Ireland, United Kingdom, France, United States
omdb.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 8 wins & 32 nominations total

title: Legally Blonde
curatorNote: Comédia aclamada de Robert Luketic com Reese Witherspoon. Julgada como fútil e intelectualmente incapaz pelo namorado por causa de seu visual rosa e loiro, Elle Woods entra em Direito em Harvard para provar seu valor.
curatorReason: Uma declaração empoderadora sobre nunca diminuir a própria autenticidade ou estilo para caber nas caixas preconceituosas dos outros.

omdb.title: Legally Blonde
omdb.writer: Amanda Brown, Karen McCullah, Kirsten Smith
omdb.actors: Reese Witherspoon, Luke Wilson, Selma Blair
omdb.plot: Elle Woods is a fashionable sorority queen of her college -- she has it all, a handsome boyfriend, wealth, and status. Things begin to change for Elle when her boyfriend, Warner dumps her and he starts dating Vivian, a law student. Elle decides to win back her former boyfriend by applying to Harvard Law School, she is able to pass her test and get into Harvard. Being in Harvard may not be easy for Elle, she soon falls in love with Emmett and she befriends Paulette, a manicurist at the nail salon. Along the way, Elle decides to take her studies more seriously and she must take on a court case when her role model Brooke Windham is accused of murdering her husband. Elle is determined to prove Brooke's innocence.

title: Easy A
curatorNote: Comédia inteligente e aclamada estrelada por Emma Stone. Uma estudante comum do ensino médio inventa uma mentira para parecer mais experiente, mas os boatos fogem ao controle.
curatorReason: Uma sátira espirituosa inspirada em 'A Letra Escarlate' sobre a necessidade desesperada de validação social, julgamento moral hipócrita e reconstrução da autoimagem.

omdb.title: Easy A
omdb.actors: Emma Stone, Amanda Bynes, Penn Badgley
omdb.plot: After a little white lie about losing her virginity gets out, a clean cut high school girl sees her life paralleling Hester Prynne's in "The Scarlet Letter," which she is currently studying in school - until she decides to use the rumor mill to advance her social and financial standing.

title: Girl, Interrupted
curatorNote: Vencedor do Oscar de Melhor Atriz Coadjuvante para Angelina Jolie, estrelando Winona Ryder. Uma jovem desorientada com sensação de inadequação e vazio existencial é internada em uma instituição psiquiátrica nos anos 60.
curatorReason: Uma imersão realista nas dores da juventude fraturada, nos dilemas de identidade e no processo difícil de reconstruir o afeto por si mesma.

omdb.title: Girl, Interrupted
omdb.writer: James Mangold, Lisa Loomer, Anna Hamilton Phelan
omdb.actors: Winona Ryder, Angelina Jolie, Clea DuVall
omdb.plot: In 1967, Susanna Kaysen has a headache and chases a bottle of aspirin with a bottle of vodka. This lands her in the mental institution Claymoore, where Dr. Melvin Potts diagnoses her with borderline personality disorder. When she arrives at Claymoore Nurse Valerie Owens greets her and shows her around the women's ward where she meets Georgina Tuskin, a pathological liar fixated on "The Wizard of Oz"; Polly Clark, a childish schizophrenic; Janet Webber, a sardonic anorexic patient; Daisy Randone who won't let anyone into her room and only eats her father's chicken; and Lisa Rowe, a sociopath who controls the other patients and makes the Claymoore nurses' lives hell. Through the movie, Lisa gains and loses control over Susanna and shows how bad she can be. How long will Susanna last at Claymoore and how does she take back control of her life? This movie battles subjects such as mental heath, abuse, self-harm and suicide.

title: Juno
curatorNote: Vencedor do Oscar de Melhor Roteiro Original de Diablo Cody com Elliot Page e Michael Cera. Uma adolescente sarcástica e excêntrica enfrenta uma gravidez precoce e as mudanças radicais em seu corpo e vida.
curatorReason: Um retrato sensível sobre autodefesa irônica, as inseguranças físicas e emocionais da gestação na adolescência e a busca por um lugar no mundo.

omdb.title: Juno
omdb.actors: Elliot Page, Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner
omdb.plot: A tale told over four seasons, starting in autumn when Juno, a 16-year-old high-school junior in Minnesota, discovers she's pregnant after one event in a chair with her best friend, Bleeker. In the waiting room of an abortion clinic, the quirky and whip-sharp Juno decides to give birth and to place the child with an adoptive couple. She finds one in the PennySaver personals, contacts them, tells her dad and step-mother, and carries on with school. The chosen parents, upscale yuppies (one of whom is cool and laid back, the other meticulous and uptight), meet Juno, sign papers, and the year unfolds. Will Juno's plan work, can she improvise, and what about Bleeker?

title: Anger Management
curatorNote: Comédia de grande sucesso com Adam Sandler e Jack Nicholson. Um homem tímido, pacífico e sem assertividade que sempre se anula perante os outros é forçado a fazer terapia de controle de raiva com um terapeuta excêntrico.
curatorReason: Aborda com humor terapêutico a síndrome da boazinha/passivo que oculta profundo medo de rejeição e incapacidade de impor limites e se valorizar.

omdb.title: Anger Management
omdb.actors: Jack Nicholson, Adam Sandler, Marisa Tomei
omdb.plot: Mild-mannered timid businessman Dave Buznik works for a pet clothing company out of New York City. He's got an abrasive boss named Mr. Frank Head who frequently takes credit for his work and steps on him in return. He's got a loving girlfriend, Linda, whose best friend is her condescending college ex, Andrew. But when a misunderstanding aboard an airplane goes haywire, Dave is ordered by the court to undergo anger management therapy at the hands of specialist Dr. Buddy Rydell, who is an unpredictable, psychopathic character. As the relationship between Dave and Buddy becomes more tense, when the unorthodox treatment wreaks havoc Dave's life, and Buddy might be the only one who can save him from a problem he recognizes right away in his patient, that could only get worse.

title: Bruce Almighty
curatorNote: Comédia clássica com Jim Carrey, Morgan Freeman e Jennifer Aniston. Um repórter frustrado e cheio de inveja dos colegas culpa Deus por sua mediocridade e recebe poderes divinos por uma semana.
curatorReason: Uma lição hilária sobre gratidão, parar de se comparar aos outros e compreender que a verdadeira dignidade começa por reconhecer o próprio valor interior.

omdb.title: Bruce Almighty
omdb.writer: Steve Koren, Mark O'Keefe, Steve Oedekerk
omdb.actors: Jim Carrey, Jennifer Aniston, Morgan Freeman
omdb.plot: Bruce Nolan, a television reporter in Buffalo, NY, is discontented with almost everything in life despite his popularity and the love of his girlfriend Grace. At the end of the worst day of his life, Bruce angrily ridicules and rages against God and God responds. God appears in human form and, endowing Bruce with divine powers, challenges Bruce to take on the big job to see if he can do it any better.

title: Dumbo
curatorNote: Obra-prima histórica da Disney. Um filhote de elefante que nasce com orelhas gigantescas é ridicularizado impiedosamente por todos ao seu redor, até descobrir que sua suposta deformidade é sua maior dádiva.
curatorReason: O símbolo máximo da superação do estigma estético: aquilo que o mundo tenta usar para te humilhar pode ser exatamente a sua maior força para voar.

omdb.title: Dumbo
omdb.director: Samuel Armstrong, Norman Ferguson, Wilfred Jackson
omdb.writer: Joe Grant, Dick Huemer, Otto Englander
omdb.actors: Sterling Holloway, Edward Brophy, James Baskett
omdb.plot: The stork delivers a baby elephant to Mrs. Jumbo, veteran of the circus, but the newborn is ridiculed because of his truly enormous ears and dubbed "Dumbo". After being separated from his mother, Dumbo is relegated to the circus' clown acts; it is up to his only friend, a mouse, to assist Dumbo to achieve his full potential.

title: 10 Things I Hate About You
ptTitle: 10 Coisas que Eu Odeio em Você
curatorNote: Adaptação cult de 'A Megera Domada' de Shakespeare com Heath Ledger e Julia Stiles. Kat Stratford usa o cinismo e o isolamento como escudo contra a hipocrisia e as expectativas sociais da escola.
curatorReason: Um clássico dos anos 90 sobre a coragem de não se submeter à necessidade de agradar os outros para ser aceita.

omdb.title: 10 Things I Hate About You
omdb.writer: Karen McCullah, Kirsten Smith, William Shakespeare
omdb.actors: Heath Ledger, Julia Stiles, Joseph Gordon-Levitt
omdb.plot: Adapted from William Shakespeare's play "The Taming of the Shrew," 10 Things I Hate About You starts off with Cameron, new student at Padua High, sitting in the office of the quirky guidance counselor Ms. Perky. He is then shown around the school by Michael, who will become his best friend. During his tour is when Cameron first sees Bianca Stratford, a beautiful sophomore with one problem: she isn't allowed to date. And neither is her "shrew" sister, Katarina, a senior who loves indie rock and feminist prose and hates conformity. But Kat and Bianca's father alters his house rule: now, Bianca can date... as long as Kat has a date, too. Now, in order for Cameron to date Bianca, he has to find someone to date Kat. So Michael helps him enlist the help of pretty-boy/jerk/model Joey Donner, tricking him into thinking that *he* will get to take Bianca out if he pays someone to take out Kat. His choice: Patrick Verona, a bad-boy with a mysterious reputation--some say he ate a live duck once, others that he lit a state trooper on fire, and even more claim that he had a brief porn career. Will Patrick win Kat's heart? Will Cameron win Bianca's? Or will everything hit the fan...?

streamName: 10 Coisas que Eu Odeio em Você

title: Just My Luck
curatorNote: Comédia romântica estrelada por Lindsay Lohan e Chris Pine. Jake é um jovem desastrado, com autoestima abalada e que atrai azar constante, cuja vida se inverte ao beijar a mulher mais sortuda de Manhattan.
curatorReason: Uma metáfora divertida sobre como a crença na própria incapacidade gera autossabotagem e como a autoconfiança altera nossa postura perante a vida.

omdb.title: Just My Luck
omdb.writer: I. Marlene King, Amy Harris, Jonathan Bernstein
omdb.actors: Lindsay Lohan, Chris Pine, Samaire Armstrong
omdb.plot: In Manhattan, Ashley Albright is a lucky woman and very successful in the agency where she works. The clumsy Jake Hardin is an unlucky aspirant manager of the rock band McFly, who is unsuccessfully trying to contact the entrepreneur Damon Phillips to promote his band. When Ashley meets Jake in a masquerade party, they kiss each other, swapping her fortune with his bad luck.

title: Wild Child
curatorNote: Comédia adolescente estrelada por Emma Roberts. Uma jovem mimada e vaidosa de Malibu com carência afetiva é enviada pelo pai para um rígido colégio interno na Inglaterra.
curatorReason: Uma jornada de amadurecimento onde a protagonista despe-se da armadura da futilidade e da vaidade superficial para encontrar lealdade e autoestima verdadeira.

omdb.title: Wild Child
omdb.actors: Emma Roberts, Aidan Quinn, Natasha Richardson
omdb.plot: Since Malibu brat Poppy Moore's mom passed away, she has pushed her rich, usually-absent dad Gerry shamelessly. When his patience wears out, she's shipped off to Abbey Mount, her mother's former English boarding school. On her first day she makes enemies of most of her dorm-mates, especially dominant lacrosse school captain Harriet, and the school's principal Mrs. Kingsley. Unwilling to accept the strict regime, she decides to misbehave and take the blame for everyone until she's dismissed. The school's only appealing feature is Kingsley's dashing son Freddie. Then the dream prince transfers his favor from ambitious, uptight Harriet to unruly Poppy, which changes everything.

title: She's the Man
curatorNote: Adaptação moderna de 'Noite de Reis' com Amanda Bynes e Channing Tatum. Impedida de jogar futebol por ser mulher, Viola se disfarça de seu irmão gêmeo em um colégio rival para provar sua capacidade física e atlética.
curatorReason: Uma comédia eletrizante sobre derrubar barreiras de gênero, vencer a subestimação e provar que talento e determinação independem do sexo biológico.

omdb.title: She's the Man
omdb.writer: Ewan Leslie, Karen McCullah, Kirsten Smith
omdb.actors: Amanda Bynes, Laura Ramsey, Channing Tatum
omdb.plot: Viola Hastings (Bynes) is in a real jam. Complications threaten her scheme to pose as her twin brother, Sebastian (James Kirk), and take his place at a new boarding school. She falls in love with her handsome roommate, Duke (Tatum), who loves beautiful Olivia (Ramsey), who has fallen for Sebastian. As if that were not enough, Viola's twin returns from London ahead of schedule but has no idea that his sister has already replaced him on campus.

title: Me and Earl and the Dying Girl
ptTitle: Eu, Você e a Garota Que Vai Morrer
curatorNote: Vencedor do Grande Prêmio do Júri e do Público no Festival de Sundance. Greg Gaines, um adolescente com severo ódio de si mesmo e terror de ser julgado, é obrigado pela mãe a passar tempo com uma colega com leucemia.
curatorReason: Uma obra comovente e autêntica sobre a desconstrução do autodesprezo adolescente e a descoberta de que a vida ganha sentido quando temos coragem de nos importar com alguém.

omdb.title: Me and Earl and the Dying Girl
omdb.actors: Thomas Mann, RJ Cyler, Olivia Cooke
omdb.plot: Seventeen-year-old Greg has managed to become part of every social group at his Pittsburgh high school without having any friends, but his life changes when his mother forces him to befriend Rachel, a girl he once knew in Hebrew school who has leukemia.ndnd
